idris.name: Lexp_7_2__arith
idris.note: The arithmetic operators of the fragment: + - * // %.

idris.name: lexp_7_2__int_op
idris.note: Int op Int is Int, wrapped, except `/`, a Float ([LEXP.7.4]); a zero divisor under /, // or % is [LEXP.7.15.1]'s trap, raised before any division.

idris.name: lexp_7_2__int_right
idris.note: The right operand of an Int-left arithmetic: Int computes, null propagates, else ill-typed.

idris.name: lexp_7_2__negate
idris.note: Unary minus on an Int is an Int, wrapped.

idris.name: lnul_4_1__arith
idris.note: All operands Int, result Int (`/` a Float); an Int beside a Float promotes and the result is a Float; any other non-null pairing is ill-typed.
